briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly open a new position, so we're holding steady rather than forcing a trade into a neutral tape.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today our available cash was below the threshold needed to safely open a new position, and the market gave no strong risk-on signal, so the disciplined choice is to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊、待有明確機會時才動用的現金。今日可用現金未達到安全開新倉的門檻，加上市場亦未發出明確的風險偏好訊號，因此紀律性的做法是保留現金，而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, a mild pullback rather than a decisive move in either direction. No major catalysts stood out, consistent with a quiet, low-conviction trading session. Without a strong directional signal, the safer play is to hold existing positions and wait for clearer confirmation before deploying more cash.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市略為回軟，納指下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，屬溫和調整而非明確方向性走勢。市場缺乏重大催化因素，符合淡靜、低信心的交易日特徵。在缺乏明確方向信號的情況下，穩健做法是持有現有倉位，待訊號更明確時才部署更多現金。
